requirements.evidence: Migrations match the schema exactly: entities_slug_unique and soft deletes (create_entities_table.php:16-21); stored generated owner_seq plus the entity_memberships_one_owner and entity_memberships_entity_user_unique indexes (create_entity_memberships_table.php:18-29). The contract is met: Entity getRouteKeyName/memberships/users/owner (Entity.php:23-54), EntityMembership cast and scopes (EntityMembership.php:31-79), UserRole::manageable (UserRole.php:16), User::membershipFor (User.php:53), factories with owner/admin/employee states. Policies follow the role matrix (EntityPolicy.php, EntityMembershipPolicy.php:21-28). The middleware covers 403 and the 0/1/>1 dispatch (ResolveCurrentEntity.php:28-44). Pick authorizes, writes an audit log and redirects (EntityController.php:24-35). Onboarding uses a transaction, the owner role is fixed, slug retry calls the overridable uniqueSlug on each attempt, and the audit log, session and redirect are in place (CreateEntity.php:41-69). The switcher uses the is-link/is-light classes with data-current (switcher.blade.php:9-14). The navbar link shows only with count > 1 (default-page.blade.php:14). Lang keys exist in both locales. Dashboard 403 for non-members comes from authorize in mount (Dashboard.php:20).

conventions.evidence: Follows: #[Validate] + $this->validate() (CreateEntity.php:26,33); policies used through authorize/Gate::authorize; #[Fillable] on both models; reversible down() in the migrations; the existing x-form-field/x-button components are reused (create-entity.blade.php:5-8); docs/database-schema.md, architecture.md, business-rules.md and CHANGELOG are updated. Deviation: the entity+owner creation is a domain write done inline in the Livewire component (CreateEntity.php:43-53) and not in an app/Actions/CreateEntity class, which the conventions require.

security.evidence: submit() authorizes ('create', Entity::class) before validating, and the role is fixed server-side as UserRole::Owner (CreateEntity.php:31,49). Dashboard has #[Locked] public Entity and authorizes view in mount (Dashboard.php:14-20). Pick uses Gate::authorize('view', $entity) before touching the session (EntityController.php:26). ResolveCurrentEntity is registered as Livewire persistent middleware (AppServiceProvider.php:44). Onboarding is rate limited (CreateEntity.php:35-37). All output uses {{ }} escaping. No weakness found.

tests.evidence: EntityDataModelTest covers the indexes, both DB-level owner rejections (insert and in-place promotion), cascades, scopes and full policy matrices. EntityTenantTest covers guest/unverified redirects, all /home branches, middleware context/403/dispatch, deleted session entity, persistent middleware, pick happy path with the audit event and the forbidden case with the session untouched, switcher markup and translation, navbar visibility, dashboard 403 with a session for another entity, a locked-entity tamper test, onboarding validation, slug derivation, insert-time collision retry and give-up with rollback, and rate limiting.

simplicity.evidence: Mostly lean: the policies use small isOwnerOrAdmin helpers and the onboarding view reuses existing components. Some indirection and duplication: HomeController re-implements the session lookup that the middleware also does (HomeController.php:18-25), and CurrentEntity::dispatch returns an Entity|RedirectResponse union that every caller has to branch on (CurrentEntity.php:51, ResolveCurrentEntity.php:34-36, HomeController.php:27-29).

readability.evidence: Clear names and focused methods, plus helpful comments on non-obvious points (create_entity_memberships_table.php:21-23, CreateEntity.php:45-46, routes/web.php:27). The open-ended for ($attempt = 1; ; $attempt++) loop with break/throw (CreateEntity.php:41-59) and the mixed-return dispatch() take some effort to follow. No dead code or debug output.

scope.evidence: Every file serves the task. Small extras (rate limiting, RESERVED_SLUGS = ['switcher'] at Entity.php:21) are justified by the conventions or by the /e/switcher route. Deleting home.blade.php follows from /home becoming a redirect. No out-of-scope members or settings pages, locale middleware or navbar redesign.

issues.explanation: Creating the entity and its owner membership is a domain write, and the conventions require it to live in an app/Actions class (for example CreateEntity), not inline in the Livewire component.

When a member of two entities has session entity A and opens /e/B, the request's tenant context is set to A while B's dashboard renders; access is still correctly authorized, but the context and the routed entity disagree.
HomeController duplicates the session lookup and Entity|RedirectResponse branching that ResolveCurrentEntity already does.

issues.location: tests/Feature/EntityTenantTest.php (onboarding keeps the creator as owner)
issues.explanation: The tamper test sets a non-existent 'role' property, so it only shows that unknown properties are rejected, not that a real client input cannot change the owner.
The condition-less for loop with break/rethrow is harder to read than a bounded loop or retry() helper.

review.summary: Implements the full entity data model (portable DB-enforced single owner), policies, tenant middleware with the Livewire persistent registration, onboarding with insert-time slug retry, pick, switcher, navbar link and dashboard. Docs and changelog are updated, and the tests are thorough, including authorization, tamper and race cases. The main deviation is that the domain write is not placed in an app/Actions class; the rest are minor design nits, so this is approve with small changes.
